note: On a conflict under a declared-generated path, look up the FILE row before resolving, not the directory row. docs/audits/ declares author=artifacts at the DIRECTORY level, and three different mechanisms actually write files under it. The Kerf absorbed 77 commits and got four conflicts in that tree needing two OPPOSITE resolutions: plumb-roster.md, type-audit-report.md and decisions-in-force.md are artifacts-authored (take a side, make rebaseline, commit what the generator produces), while campaign-reconciliation.tsv is hand-authored by each campaign at close and must keep BOTH sides appended rows by hand. Resolving that one by regeneration runs a regenerator that does not exist and silently drops one sides rows -- which is what reddened campaign/the-warp on 2026-09-05, and why c610c9363 added its none(...) override. The check is one command: grep the exact path in docs/generated-paths.txt. No row means it INHERITS the directory author, and inheriting is the case worth checking rather than the case to assume.
